label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'pricing.py' — a small pricing module, at least 100 lines long, with a module docstring and these terse-named functions, each documented: 'base_price(item)' returns item["price"]; 'net_price(item, pct)' applies a discount; 'bulk_price(items)' sums net prices; 'round_price(n)' rounds to cents; 'tax_price(n, rate)' adds tax. Make sure 'base_price' is referenced several times across the module. Also write 'tests/test_pricing.py' covering 'base_price' and 'round_price'.
